name: Diwali
tagline: Diyas, rangoli and marigolds in festive finery.
description: Celebrate the festival of lights: glowing diyas, rangoli at the doorstep, marigold torans, sparklers on the rooftop, mithai platters, puja thalis and fireworks over the city. Silk sarees, lehengas, kurtas and bandhgalas styled with care and warm, golden candlelight.
